Retrieve all targets that are currently part of a collection with pagination support.

Returns paginated target references with basic information about each target (ID and name).
To get detailed target information, use the targets API with these target IDs.

Add multiple targets (suppliers, customers, etc.) to a collection.

Targets are identified by their unique `prewaveTargetId` (target's `infotag_id`). If a target is already in the collection,
it will be ignored (no duplicate entries). All target IDs must be valid and accessible to the user.

This operation is atomic - either all targets are added successfully, or none are added.

items.docs:
Remove a single target from a collection.

The target is identified by its `prewaveTargetId` (target's `infotag_id`) in the URL path. If the target is not
currently in the collection, the operation will complete successfully without error (idempotent operation).
